name: research-center-gate
description: Proves the Research Center placement prerequisite (#442) is real from the player's side: clicking "Queue Research" with no Research Center placed produces an on-screen rejection and spends no cash, and the identical click succeeds — spending the tier-2 cost-only amount and eventually unlocking the tier — once a Research Center is placed by clicking, not by console.

beats.goal: start a fresh site with money to spend and nothing built
place a living quarters, tier 1, with no Research Center on site
click Queue Research on the living quarters — no Research Center exists yet, so this must be rejected on screen rather than silently accepted

expect.note: Cash unchanged and no research queued proves the click was rejected (Build a Research Center before queueing research), not silently swallowed. The FAIL/beat screenshot should show that rejection text in the build panel's status line.

beats.goal: click the same Queue Research control on the living quarters again — now that a Research Center is placed, the tier-2 cost-only task must actually queue

expect.note: Cash dropped by exactly the tier-2 cost-only research price ($5,000, 0 ticks, no conditions per RESEARCH_TASK_DEFS) — the task actually queued this time, purely from clicking.

beats.goal: let the cost-only research task resolve

expect.note: 0-tick research resolves on the first tick processed after queueing; the following beat proves it by using the newly unlocked tier.

beats.goal: tier 2 living quarters is now placeable — the unlock is real, not just a queued task

expect.note: The tier-2 Place button is disabled while the tier is locked. It only becomes usable once isTierUnlocked() is true, so this is proof the research actually completed rather than merely being accepted.
